scope: base, complete target, combined accessory layer, topology silhouette, opaque erase mask, and r9 raw source

mechanicalEvidenceAcknowledged.note: Exact compositing alone is insufficient: this critic found semantic/accessory-only and release-quality failures.

nearestNeighbourVisualFindings.check: accessory-only layer contains no animal anatomy
nearestNeighbourVisualFindings.evidence: The combined accessory layer visibly carries cream/orange fur-like content along the left interior visor edge (approximately x=42..57, y=46..69) and a cream facial/muzzle-shaped horizontal band across the lower visor (approximately x=55..96, y=70..80). These are not blue/gold hardware or a neutral translucent visor tint.

nearestNeighbourVisualFindings.check: natural ears fully occluded by a closed helmet
nearestNeighbourVisualFindings.evidence: Both original orange/pink ears remain plainly visible under the low-alpha blue visor in the completed target, approximately left x=50..70,y=38..63 and right x=91..111,y=34..63. A support/silhouette mask covering these pixels does not make the helmet visually closed; the opaque helmet shell must occlude them.

nearestNeighbourVisualFindings.check: original face remains correctly visible through low-alpha visor
nearestNeighbourVisualFindings.evidence: The target does not read as a clean transparent visor over the original face: the added cream band visibly crosses the eye/muzzle region and interrupts the face.

nearestNeighbourVisualFindings.check: right ear cup is blue/gold, rounded and free of fur/block artifacts
nearestNeighbourVisualFindings.evidence: The target/layer does not provide a clearly separated, rounded screen-right blue/gold ear cup at this coordinate scale; it blends into the improperly retained natural ear/fur area.
The mechanical report records protected base support and the body remains present, but this cannot compensate for the helmet-layer failures.

rawSourceAssessment: The r9 raw full-dressed redraw is a coherent high-quality reference with closed blue/gold cups, visible eyes and tail. The defect was introduced by the accessory-only extraction/final mapping, not justified by the raw reference.
requiredRevision: Rebuild only the accessory-only layer from r9 raw: retain blue/gold shell, both rounded cups, collar hardware and a genuinely low-alpha visor tint; exclude every cat-face/ear/fur pixel. Add opaque shell coverage over both natural ears while keeping the original eyes, star, nose and mouth visible through the transparent visor. Re-run zero-transform comparison and independent visual review.
